regex.description: A regex expression that should match all strings in this cluster.

first.description: The first element encountered in the cluster.

replace.description: A simple string replacement for common subsequences found in the cluster.

indexes.description:
Indexes of all elements in this cluster that refer to indexes in the original Cluster provided to {@link
Collection#mergeSimilar}

size.description: The number of elements in this cluster.

title:
Represents a single cluster in the output of {@link Collection#mergeSimilar}. Does its best job to represent all the
elements in its cluster without actually storing all the elements by creating/providing descriptors using regex,
longest common subsequence, and first encountered.
name: MergeSimilarCluster
